faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Stenographer Grade-III posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Stenographer Grade-III posts is 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed PUC or a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice or equivalent. Additionally, Senior Grade Shorthand and Typing in Kannada and English, along with computer knowledge, are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Stenographer Grade-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for various categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies for the Stenographer Grade-III post in the Bengaluru Rural District Court.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General/OBC category candidates. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Stenographer Grade-III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 44425 to Rs. 83700 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test (Shorthand and Typing), followed by an Interview, Document Verification, and finally, the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Stenographer Grade-III position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of the Bengaluru Rural District Court. The application link will be active from 17 August 2026 to 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for reserved categories. For example, SC/ST/Category-1 candidates have a maximum age limit of 40+5 years, and other categories also have specific relaxations.
